method: Visible browsers with fresh profiles and normal HTTPS discovery; NFQUEUE injects UDP loss without altering QUIC/TLS payloads. Peer certificates remain verified. Chromium snapshot 1727495 is emulated Linux x64; Firefox is an official Linux arm64 executable. TLS key logs enable offline Wireshark decryption. No forced QUIC, UA override or certificate bypass. Original PCAPs have zero kernel capture drops. Initial six analysis files combine captured server IP packets with exact queued client UDP payloads in synthetic IP/UDP envelopes. Missing-Initial analysis retains exact raw IP packets at the queue hook with an arbitrary time origin. Analysis is not an OS timing oracle.
